steps: Open public entry and reach /signup (Sign up link on the Log In panel or footer).
Complete the onboarding questionnaire and create the free account.
From the member area open the Upgrade to Elite plan modal (sidebar card or settings upgrade card).
Choose Elite Annual 'Buy plan' -> /elite/checkout?isMyJefit=true&sub=yearly (clone-local checkout continuation).
Complete payment with the local-sandbox approved scenario.
Land back on /my-jefit/settings Account tab and verify Account Type shows the Elite annual membership.
journeys.failure_variant: sandbox-declined scenario surfaces a decline and creates no order/membership
journeys.note: Source post-payment state unavailable (payment never performed on source); post-payment destination-view content is clone-local behavior built on the frozen Account-tab structure and disclosed as such.

steps: Open /login (H1 'Log In'; username-or-email + password; Google/Apple/Facebook IdP buttons rendered).
Submit seeded member credentials.
Land on /my-jefit dashboard with sidebar and Discover feed.
journeys.failure_variant: wrong credentials -> inline error, no session

steps: From /login click 'Forgot Password?'.
Verify /login/forgot-password: H1 'Reset Password', email field, 'Send reset link' button, 'Log in' return link.
Return to sign-in without sending a reset message.
Open /exercises (1295 EXERCISES FOUND, muscle + equipment chips).
Apply muscle filter 'Abs' (client-side; count drops, FILTERS/CLEAR FILTERS chips).
Open /exercises/2/barbell-bench-press and inspect target muscles, equipment, difficulty, type, log type, instructions.
journeys.failure_variant: impossible filter combo -> '0 EXERCISES FOUND' empty grid
journeys.recovery_variant: CLEAR FILTERS restores the full list
journeys.note: Source detail pages have no ratings section; ht-05's 'community ratings' has no source equivalent and is disclosed as a gap against the trace text.

steps: Open /routines (quick categories, Sort by Most Downloaded/Most Viewed/Latest).
Open /routines/19113/6-weeks-to-six-pack-abs: tag pills, Share/Download, Plan Details, day cards with Sets x Reps rows, Featured plans carousel.
Open /my-jefit/workouts (My Plans).
Click 'Create Plan' (server-side create) -> /my-jefit/workouts/edit?id=<id> Routine Builder.
Set routine name; add exercises from the library (default 3 sets, 10 lbs x 8, 60s rest).
Edit a set's weight/reps/rest; builder autosaves.
Save (return to plans list) and verify the named routine appears with its day/focus/level metadata.
journeys.failure_variant: empty routine name is silently ignored on source (no validation error) — reproduced as-is
journeys.recovery_variant: plan card menu: Edit Plan / Set as current plan / Delete

steps: Open /my-jefit/progress/history (calendar + day panel, 'No logs' empty state).
Click '+ Add session' -> Workout Log modal (Start/End time, exercise library).
Add an exercise (logs a default set; Training Summary updates: timers, Complete, Volume, records).
Close the modal; day panel shows the persisted Training Summary with per-set rows and record badge.
journeys.failure_variant: day with no session shows 'No logs — You don't have any logs for this day.'
journeys.recovery_variant: session row links to per-exercise progress view

steps: Open /my-jefit/settings Profile tab: unit system Imperial/Metric, workout level, top goal (Maintaining/Bulking/Cutting/Strength).
Open Privacy tab: visibility selects and Email Preferences switches (Training Reports, Promotional Emails, Product Tips).
Open /my-jefit/progress/body-stats and set a stat goal via 'Edit stat'.
Verify changed values persist and display.
Open /my-jefit Q&A and Popular feeds (post cards, likes/comments counts).
Open the 'Create Post +' dialog and dismiss without posting.
journeys.note: Publishing is out of scope (no third-party-visible effects); clone-local posting is real local behavior against seeded feed data.

steps: Open /support (Contact us, Subscription support, Technical support) and /support/faq (categorized numbered Q&A).
Search /exercises for 'zzzz-no-match-websitebench' or apply an impossible filter combo -> '0 EXERCISES FOUND'; CLEAR FILTERS recovers.
Open a non-existent deep link -> source-faithful unbranded server 404 ('Not Found', title '404 Not Found').
Open a protected member route signed out -> client redirect to /login?redirect=<path>.
journeys.note: ht-22 expects a branded not-found; the source's real behavior is an unbranded server 404 and the clone reproduces the source. Disclosed as a trace-text/source divergence.

steps: Open the public entry and use primary navigation (Products/Workouts/Exercises/More) to reach the workout-tracking sections; verify destination heading and canonical path.
Open /signup and verify the questionnaire entry, progress bar, back control, and (at the account-creation step) identity fields, terms links, and verification guidance without creating an account.
Open the Upgrade to Elite plan modal (Basic Included / Elite $12.99 / Elite Annual $52.49-then-$69.99).
Open /elite public pricing and /support subscription-management links (upgrade/payment/cancel options).
